newsitem.title: JAPAN: Muto urges BOJ to consider raising discount rate.
newsitem.headline: Muto urges BOJ to consider raising discount rate.

text.p: Cabinet minister Kabun Muto urged the Bank of Japan (BOJ) on Tuesday to consider the possibility of raising the official discount rate (ODR), a spokesman at the Management and Coordination Agency said.
Muto is director-general of the agency.

Asked if Muto made any reference to a possible rise in the ODR at this morning's economic ministers' meeting, the spokesman quoted Muto as saying: "I asked (BOJ's Yasuo Matsushita) to consider the possibility."
Muto said that growth in Japan's money supply has been slow and this can be explained by the outflow of Japanese funds into higher yielding assets overseas, the spokesman said.
